SPXI instrument · method 0.16 of 87, level 0 (Measurement): The Negative of the Negative (/non). An instrument of SPXI, the Semantic Packet for eXchange & Indexing; the whole practice is itemized at spxi.dev/methods.

111 entities, 71 composed, 40 listed and not yet composed; alphabetical. Entity before address (Lee Sharks, 2026-10-07): '/non is keyed to entity before address. /non is concerned with constructing the entity, theophrastus, prior to the address at which that entity can be found.' Each entry is an entity; its addresses are the strings at which it is sought. An observation in the register is made at an address and belongs to its entity. Rows enter and change here, versioned with date and reason, until the procedure (§§3–5) is frozen; the address list is frozen after it (§7.0).
